message: Last week, as I was trying to explain to my kids why we should have extra snacks and water ready for the storm, they were busy building a pillow fort and insisting it was our new hurricane bunker. I suppose if all else fails, at least we'll have a cozy place to ride out the chaos. Who knew storm prep could spark such creativity? Just another reminder that a little planning can make a big difference, even if it looks like a playdate.
